summary: Collection roles must have lowercase alphanumeric/underscore names starting with a letter and can't contain plugins; the directory name is the role name, role_name metadata is ignored, and noncompliant names fail Galaxy import.
questions: Why did Galaxy reject my collection because of a role name?
Can roles inside a collection have their own plugins?
Does role_name in meta/main.yml work inside a collection?
What do I need to change when moving a traditional role into a collection?

answer_card.title: Roles in collections
answer_card.answer_md:
- Role names: lowercase alphanumerics and `_`, starting with a letter. The **directory name** is the role name; non-compliant names fail Galaxy import.
- Roles can't contain plugins; put them in the collection's `plugins/` (available to all roles).
- When migrating traditional roles, rename if needed and move role plugins.
- `role_name` metadata is **ignored** in collections.
